allowances.title: Allowances and benefits
allowances.subtitle: Allowances and deductions on staff records · every line shows on the payslip and in the salary register under its own name
allowances.noRight: The Payroll right is needed to see allowances. Ask Admin.

kpi.people: People with a line this month

allowances.emptyBody: No allowance or deduction lines are on staff records yet. Adding them from this screen comes in a later slice; payroll adds the lines running in the month.
allowances.howBody: Payroll adds every allowance running in the month to gross pay and takes every deduction off. The tax, PF and ESI treatment of each type is set by Admin with the CA; PF and ESI stay off until the CA confirms them.
